descriptions: This dataset contains a guide document for all of the Arab West Report Full Transcript Interviews which can be found in the Arab West Report Special Reports datasets according to year, and this dataset, which contains all of the 12 Arab West Report Full Transcript interviews that were not included as a part of other datasets. The interviews not uploaded as a part of this dataset can be located in other datasets using this directory.
While the interviews in this dataset were conducted in English, Arabic, and Dutch, all transcripts are written in English. There are no audio files present.
